name: Theban Necropolis
heritage: part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
text: The Theban Necropolis (Arabic: مدينة طيبة الجنائزية, romanized: Madīnat Ṭaybah al-Janāʼizīyah) is a necropolis on the west bank of the Nile, opposite Thebes (Luxor) in Upper Egypt. It was used for ritual burials for much of the Pharaonic period, especially during the New Kingdom.

depictions.name: Theban Necropolis
depictions.text: The Theban Necropolis is a great cemetery situated on the west bank of the Nile, opposite Thebes in Upper Egypt. It was home to the tombs of pharaohs from the New Kingdom period and nobles of Egypt, most notably the Valley of the Kings and the Necropolis of the Nobles.
